plan.title: Line-wise award with missing second line

steps.note: Open the existing prepared closed RFQ directly in Master QCS.
Enable the tenant configuration required for eRFX projects.
Verify both bidding vendors are present in the comparison grid.
Verify the available prepared line has Vendor B's stated rate.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate the only prepared line to Vendor B for its full requested quantity.
Assert the available allocation counters and calculated proposal value.
Create the award proposal from the available allocation.
Fill mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the proposal so it becomes available for approval.
Verify the proposal is pending approval.
